title: LIVE LEAF COLOR
noaa_source: NASA MODIS Aqua MYD13A1/MYD09A1 via Planetary Computer (global, 500 m)
product_name: NASA MODIS Aqua MYD13A1/MYD09A1 via Planetary Computer (global, 500 m)
variable: NDVI trajectory + surface reflectance + NDSI snow + land class -> circular phenology phase 0..1
data_time_utc: VI composite start 2026-08-05 (+16d window); reflectance 2026-08-13 (+8d); retrieved 2026-09-25 06:24 PM EDT
spatial_resolution_source: 500 m MODIS sinusoidal, reprojected to canvas (nearest)
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: ONLY currently-observed vegetated land paints — 100% the source's current information. Clouds, snow, bad QA, masked classes (urban/barren/nodata/inland-water) and Great-Lakes water stay transparent; never carried views, never modeled fills. History (observations only) feeds the trajectory baseline, never the picture.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.
attribution: Data: US NOAA. This project is not endorsed by NOAA. See DATA_SOURCES.md for exact products and endpoints.
legend_scale_html: What each color means (one trip around the year, left to right on the key): deep blue = dormant winter; light blue/cyan = spring awakening and bud break; teal-green = leaf emergence; green = growing season; yellow-green/yellow = first color; orange = autumn coloring; red/magenta = peak color into leaf drop; purple = late drop returning to deep-blue dormant (the scale wraps: both ends are winter). Color is the satellite-derived growth stage, not the color of individual trees. Only land the satellite actually saw this composite is painted — transparent = clouds, snow, cities, bare ground, water, or otherwise no current observation.
data_nature: observed satellite composites + derived phenology state

provenance.provider: NASA MODIS (Aqua) via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC
provenance.qa_rules: MYD13A1 pixel reliability 0=good/1=hold/2=snow/3=cloud; MYD09A1 state bit0 cloud; NDSI>0.4+snow test; brightness backup
provenance.landcover: USGS NLCD 2021 + NRCan 2020 Land Cover of Canada (NALCMS inputs) mosaic -> assets/leaf_landcover.png
provenance.algorithm: leaf_phenology v7 (trajectory + baseline + class + spectral gating; 19-anchor OKLab circular gradient; observed-only rendering, transparent no-data)
